value.title: Human window
value.line: One person's seat into the fleet.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: One person's seat into the fleet: it carries that person's asks to the right seats and their answers back.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: Kept while its person uses it. Closed only with the person's say.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: What its person asked and decided, in memory notes.

value.text: Serves one person, and acts for nobody else.
